decisions.reason: Conferencing draws on the firm's voice expertise, but it has gone unobserved since 2018 and faces commoditisation from cloud collaboration platforms after the pandemic, so withdrawal risk is substantial, though the firm can still run it at low marginal cost.

The metro data centre connection network rests directly on owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centre knowledge, and its documented customer adoption gives the firm results it can interpret and build on in line with its strategy.

Optical spectrum connectivity extends core fibre engineering into the high-bandwidth services the firm is heading toward, so its existing knowledge base lets it absorb what it learns and improve the service.

The number ordering portal uses the firm's software platform and regulatory know-how to support real-time provisioning, although voice services are a shrinking area where the firm has already withdrawn two related products.
